body.intent: Fix: Request plan runs fail at close-out: the daemon writes the new change set's first .rhiza/log entries untracked into the main checkout, so after the plan PR merges close-out's git pull --ff-only refuses to overwrite them (run 01M6FSQBBJYK). The plan run's log entries should be written only in its worktree, or close-out should drop untracked log files identical to the incoming ones before pulling; and a retried close-out must not fail because the first visit forgot the ship state
